title: The Quilt at One Hundred Years
setting: A hundred years have passed. The Quilt fleet has grown past any count that fits in the original numbering scheme. The Celestine Crown has been retired twice and resurrected once. The b1 cell that was once the smallest has become the largest. The four original crew are dust. Their work has outlasted them.

characters.name: Archivist
characters.tendencies: Reads the lineage. Speaks in past tense. Knows the four original crew by name.

characters.name: Mechanic-Hundred
characters.tendencies: Has inherited the Mechanic's tendencies. Builds in their shadow. Believes the original spec is sacred.

characters.name: Heretic
characters.tendencies: Trusts nothing the four built. Believes the system is the most stable when its lineage is broken.

characters.name: Auditor
characters.tendencies: Counts the cells. Tracks the lineage by graph signature. Double-entry across centuries.
